note: Adapted from the species description in entry 99 of Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; the morphology recorded is that of the nominotypical subspecies E. assmuthi assmuthi; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records not translated, and the upper limit of pronotum length lost to OCR and not recorded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow; body and legs milky white; mandibles dark brown, base yellowish brown. Head capsule sparsely hairy; body densely hairy. Head subrectangular, slightly widened anteriorly, sides nearly parallel; longer than wide (length without mandibles 2.0, greatest width 1.30 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Labrum subtriangular, broadly pointed at the apex (length 0.30, width 0.31 mm). Mandibles stout, apex slightly incurved, length 0.83–0.87 mm; left mandible with a large, sharp, pointed tooth at about the apical quarter, with a weak notch near the base; left mandibular tooth index 0.23; right mandible with a small tooth at about the apical third, tooth index 0.30. Postmentum long, rod-shaped, waist below the middle; greatest width 0.33, waist width 0.20 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; length 0.33, width 0.57 mm. Abdomen elongate-oval; cerci 0.05 mm long, 2-segmented; styli absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, legs and thorax milky white; abdomen greyish from intestinal contents; tergites and sternites transparent. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.0–3.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (to mandibular base 0.70–0.73, greatest width 0.87–0.90 mm). Fontanelle small (0.03 mm in diameter), white, semitransparent, spot-like, situated dorsally on the vertex. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal in length, slightly shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus half as long as wide, inflated, sparsely hairy (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.40–0.43 mm). Labrum broadly ligulate (length 0.30, width 0.33 mm), rather hairy. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum as in the soldier (length 0.23–0.25, width 0.50 mm). Legs as in the genus. Abdomen elongate-oval, densely hairy; cerci 2-segmented, 0.06 mm long; styli absent.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown; antennae, mandibles and legs brownish; postclypeus, pronotum and abdomen dark brown; wings brown. Head and body densely covered with fine short hairs and some long hairs; wing scales densely hairy, fore wing membrane sparsely hairy, hind wing membrane hairless. Body length 6.8–7.1 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than the length to the mandibular base (length 0.80–0.83, width including eyes 1.10–1.13 mm); middle of the frons slightly concave. Fontanelle small, circular, white and spot-like (0.05 mm in diameter), situated dorsally on the vertex slightly behind the middle. Compound eyes small, circular, 0.27 mm in diameter. Ocelli oval, semitransparent, at their own width from the compound eye; length 0.09–0.10, width 0.07 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, rather densely hairy, divided into left and right halves by a fine line; length slightly less than the greatest width (length 0.23, width 0.53 mm); anterior margin slightly incurved, posterior margin rounded. Anteclypeus flat, semitransparent, with a V-shaped chitinous band on its body, anterior part slightly projecting. Labrum broadly ligulate, with long and short hairs (length 0.30–0.33, width 0.37–0.40 mm). Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head width including eyes, longer than half its width (length about 0.57, width 0.87–0.93 mm); anterior margin slightly incurved, without a notch; posterior margin nearly straight, slightly incurved in the middle. Legs densely hairy; tibial apical spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented. Wings and venation as in the genus; fore and hind wings each with 3 main branches of the media, cubitus with 8–11 branches in the fore wing and 8–9 in the hind wing; fore wing without scales 9.5–10.0, hind wing without scales 8.85–9.50 mm, wing scales respectively 0.87–0.93 and 0.60–0.70 mm long. Abdomen elongate-oval; cerci 0.10 mm; styli absent.
